title: rutidea melanophylla
intro: Rutidea melanophylla, commonly known as African Rue or Cameroon Rue, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional use in folk medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rutidea melanophylla include its potential to alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders, due to its therapeutic actions as a nervine and sedative. The bioactive constituents of Rutidea melanophylla include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
